memberdef.name: REGISTER_IMPORTER_PLUGIN

briefdescription.para: Register an IImporterPlugin-derived class at program startup.

detaileddescription.para:
Place this macro once at namespace scope in one translation unit of the plugin. PluginClass must:
Derive from themis::importers::IImporterPlugin.
Be default-constructible.
The macro creates a function-local static instance of PluginClass and registers it with IImporterPluginRegistry::instance() before main() is entered.

simplesect.para: Because the registration runs at static-init time, the registry is effectively read-only once main() begins. Do not call registerPlugin() after the first resolve() call in production.
